hook: Latimer trained as a drilling and completion engineer at BHP Billiton before pairing an energy-track master's degree with an MBA at Stanford, then founded Fervo Energy, the enhanced-geothermal company applying oil-and-gas drilling techniques to clean baseload power. He has led the company for nearly nine years and was named a Presidential Leadership Scholar in 2022.
name: Tim Latimer

timeline.impact: Early engineering experience in Dearborn, Michigan

timeline.event: Drilling and Completion Engineer, BHP Billiton
timeline.impact: Spends nearly three years in oil and gas drilling operations in Houston

timeline.event: Master's in Energy and MBA, Stanford University
timeline.impact: Completes a joint degree in the Emmett Interdisciplinary Program in Environment and Resources and the Graduate School of Business
Joins the Fall 2018 San Francisco cohort focused on clean energy leadership
Supported as an early-stage hard-tech entrepreneur through the Activate fellowship
Founds and leads Fervo Energy, applying horizontal drilling to enhanced geothermal systems
Selected as a scholar in the bipartisan presidential leadership program
